description: Canonical Konstera capability catalogue. Edit this file to add/change a capability, then run `platform/scripts/generate-catalog-migration.py` to refresh migration 117. ADR-013.

capabilities.description: Poll a chat channel like an inbox: new messages from people (bot and app posts are skipped), oldest first, shaped like canonical tickets. Fans out across bindings like tickets.list_new; chat.reply goes to a single binding. Implementers: Slack, Microsoft Teams.

sinceIso.description: Only messages posted after this time; default: last 24 hours

url.description: Link to the message in the chat app

from.description: Sender display name (falls back to the user ID)

threadId.description: Pass to chat.reply to answer in the thread

capabilities.description: Answer a chat message in its thread where the connector can, otherwise as a new message quoting the original (threaded=false). Implementers: Slack (threaded, marks the message handled), Microsoft Teams (webhook, not threaded).

threaded.description: false when the connector could only post a new message quoting the original

markedProcessed.description: The original message is marked handled so chat.list_new skips it

capabilities.description: Actual spend for a period, grouped by service (one entry per connection). At most one year. Implementers: Azure, AWS.

sinceIso.description: Start date; default: first day of the current month

capabilities.description: Provider incidents and planned maintenance that affect this account. Fans out across bindings. Implementers: Azure, AWS (Business/Enterprise support), Google Cloud.

activeOnly.description: Only events still active or upcoming

capabilities.description: Read-only inventory of cloud resources. Fans out across bindings. Implementers: Azure, AWS (tagged resources only), Google Cloud.

type.description: Optional resource type in the provider's own form, e.g. Microsoft.Web/sites, ec2:instance, compute.googleapis.com/Instance

query.description: Optional text matched against resource names

region.description: Optional region / location, e.g. westeurope, eu-west-2, europe-west2

account.description: Subscription ID, AWS account or GCP project

capabilities.display_name: Read a file from a repository
capabilities.description: Text content of one file. Large files are cut at the connection's max_file_bytes (truncated=true). Implementers: GitHub, Azure DevOps.

ref.description: Branch, tag or commit; default: the default branch

content.description: UTF-8 text; null for binary files

capabilities.description: Find files whose content matches a query. Fans out across bindings. Implementers: GitHub.

repo.description: Optional repository; default: the connection's default or allowed repositories

capabilities.description: Look up a customer by email across the ecommerce platform. Returns identity + loyalty tier + LTV + account flags for the inbox customer context panel. Implementers: Shopify, BetterCommerce; Freshdesk/Zendesk customer records as fallback.

flags.description: Account flags â€” connector normalises vendor flags to this canonical set

ltvAmount.description: Lifetime value in order currency; absent if not computable at the connector

loyaltyTier.description: Vendor loyalty program tier if present â€” bronze/silver/gold/vip style

capabilities.description: Last N orders for a customer, newest first. Thin wrapper over the ecommerce connector's order list; implementers can delegate to orders.lookup_by_email when customerId maps 1:1 to email.
Last N returns (RMAs) for a customer, newest first, shaped as list items for the reviewer context panel. Implementers: BetterCommerce.

email.description: Fallback lookup key when customerId is absent

subtitle.description: Order number and reason for return

capabilities.description: Last N tickets for a customer (closed or open), newest first. Powers the "previous tickets" rail in the customer context panel.

email.description: Fallback lookup key when customerId is not the ticket-system's native requester id

resolutionSummary.description: One-line summary â€” connector may synthesise from the last agent reply if not provided natively

capabilities.description: Recent SQL Agent job runs and step results from msdb (newest first, at most 200). Needs SQLAgentReaderRole in msdb; not available on Azure SQL Database. Internal evidence: for understanding only, never quoted.

jobNamePattern.description: LIKE pattern for the job name; default % (all jobs)

step.description: Step name; (job outcome) for the overall result row

runAt.description: Server local time, ISO-8601 without offset

capabilities.description: Returns the T-SQL text of a procedure, view or function (OBJECT_DEFINITION), capped at 200 KB, subject to the connection's object_allowlist. Never table data. Internal evidence: for understanding only, never quoted.

name.description: schema.name or name (dbo is preferred when the schema is not given)

truncated.description: True when the text was cut at 200 KB

definition.description: Module text (T-SQL). Null for tables, encrypted modules, or without VIEW DEFINITION

capabilities.description: Finds user objects by name in a SQL Server database (sys.objects), at most 200, filtered by the connection's object_allowlist. Metadata only. Internal evidence: for understanding only, never quoted.

types.description: procedure (default), view, function, table; a string (comma-separated) or an array

pattern.description: LIKE pattern for the object name, e.g. procDWGetProductsToSync%. Optional schema part: dbo.procDW%. Letters, digits, spaces and _ % - $ # @ . only.

created.description: Server local time, ISO-8601 without offset

modified.description: Server local time, ISO-8601 without offset

capabilities.description: Execution statistics of a stored procedure from the plan cache (sys.dm_exec_procedure_stats), summed over its cached plans. Every field is null when the procedure is not in the plan cache (not run since the last restart or cache flush): that means no statistics, not zero executions. Internal evidence: for understanding only, never quoted.

name.description: schema.name or name of a stored procedure

capabilities.description: Bare-email send via SMTP/SendGrid/SES. Use tickets.reply when the source is a ticketing system; use email.send only when no ticket context exists.

linkStyle.description: How links show in the sent email: text = the label (or the host for a bare URL), button = a button, plain = the URL itself.

buttonColor.description: Button colour when linkStyle is button (#rgb or #rrggbb).

capabilities.description: Fetch one file by ID: metadata, link, and its text when the file is text-like (txt, md, html, csv, json, xml). Other formats return metadata and a link only.
Find files (and folders) by name or content in a connected file store such as OneDrive or SharePoint. Returns metadata and a link; use files.get to read a file. Implementers: OneDrive / SharePoint.
Transition a thread's status. Called by agents in their reaction code (e.g. CS agent moves to waiting_reviewer when it posts a draft, to closed when the ticket is resolved in the source system).

capabilities.display_name: Insert or update a message in a thread (dedup by external id)
capabilities.description: Insert or update a message in a thread. The (thread_id, external_message_id) UNIQUE constraint makes duplicate inserts impossible at the DB layer â€” safe to call from any insertion path (sync poll, webhook delivery, agent-authored response from tickets.reply).

created.description: true if a new row was inserted; false if an existing row matched (threadId, externalMessageId) and was updated

capabilities.display_name: Create or update a thread in the reviewer inbox
capabilities.description: Create a new thread or update an existing one keyed by (tenant, channel_type, external_ref). Platform-shipped write primitive used by ThreadMirrorService internally and callable by agents directly for non-mirrored writes.

created.description: true if a new row was inserted; false if an existing row matched (externalRef, channelType) and was updated

capabilities.description: Add a comment to an issue or work item. Needs write permission on the token. Goes to a single binding.
Open a new issue (GitHub) or work item (Azure DevOps). Needs write permission on the token. Goes to a single binding.

capabilities.display_name: Get an issue with its comments
capabilities.description: One issue or work item, with its comments. Goes to a single binding.
Issues (GitHub) or work items (Azure DevOps), most recently updated first. Pull requests are not included. Fans out across bindings.

repo.description: GitHub: owner/name. Azure DevOps: project. Default: the connection's default

sinceIso.description: Only issues updated after this time

issueId.description: GitHub issue number or Azure DevOps work item ID

capabilities.description: Fetch the full body of a single KB article by ID.
Retrieve KB articles ranked by relevance to a natural-language query. Implementers: Zendesk KB, Intercom Articles, custom REST KB, PIM content.

Runs a read-only KQL query against an Azure Monitor Log Analytics workspace (including workspace-based Application Insights tables). Bounded: max_rows, 256 KB, timeout. Internal evidence: for understanding only, never quoted.

query.description: KQL query, e.g. AppExceptions | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) | summarize count() by ProblemId. Management commands (starting with .) are refused. A | take is appended so at most max_rows rows come back.

timespan.description: ISO-8601 duration for the query window, e.g. PT1H, P1D. Default: the connection's default_timespan (P7D). At most P30D.

truncated.description: True when rows were cut at max_rows or 256 KB, a cell was cut at 8000 characters, or the service returned a partial result

capabilities.description: List the tenant's macros / canned responses from the ticket system for one-way mirror into Konstera (ADR-022 Â§Macros). Zendesk: GET /api/v2/macros.json. Freshdesk: GET /api/v2/admin/canned_responses. Intercom: GET /articles (closest analogue). Called on first connection sync and on manual re-sync.

folder.description: Filter to a specific folder/category if the ticket system groups macros

externalId.description: Ticket-system macro id â€” used as the dedup key when syncing into Konstera macros table

capabilities.description: Post a one-way notification to the connection's notification channel (e.g. tell reviewers a draft is waiting for approval). Implementers: Slack, Microsoft Teams.

url.description: Optional link, e.g. to the draft waiting for approval

text.description: Message text (plain text; light formatting where the channel supports it)

title.description: Optional short heading shown above the text

capabilities.description: List recent orders, optionally scoped to a single customer and/or a time window.

customerEmail.description: For ownership checks only â€” never shown to a customer

capabilities.description: Fetch recent orders for a customer identified by email address. Retail primary lookup. Implementers: Shopify, BigCommerce, WooCommerce, NetSuite, custom REST.

customerEmail.description: For ownership checks only â€” never shown to a customer

capabilities.description: Fetch a single order by its ID. Canonical shape returned regardless of source system.

email.description: Optional: the requester's email, used by providers to prove the order belongs to them

customerEmail.description: For ownership checks only â€” never shown to a customer

capabilities.display_name: Lookup orders by customer mobile number
capabilities.description: Fetch a customer's recent orders by mobile number, for stores that identify customers by mobile. Weaker identity proof than the sender's email: agents should flag these matches for human confirmation.

phone.description: Mobile number; providers match on the last 10 digits

customerEmail.description: For ownership checks only â€” never shown to a customer

capabilities.description: Pull requests in one repository, most recently updated first. Fans out across bindings. Implementers: GitHub, Azure DevOps.
Issue a refund against an existing order. Not all connectors implement writes; check available() before calling.
Repositories the connection can reach (limited by the token and the connection's allowed list). Fans out across bindings. Implementers: GitHub, Azure DevOps.

query.description: Optional text matched against name and description

fullName.description: Pass as repo to the other code capabilities

capabilities.display_name: Compute first-response + resolution SLA state for a thread
capabilities.description: Compute the current SLA state for a thread using the tenant's SLA policies. Platform-shipped generic computation â€” any inbox-producing agent benefits. v1 uses a tenant-wide default policy; per-channel + per-tier policies land in a follow-up.

appliedPolicy.description: Human-readable name of the policy that matched (e.g. 'VIP customer â€” 2h FRT')

capabilities.display_name: Register a thread mirror sync job
capabilities.description: Register a sync job so the platform's ThreadMirrorService (ADR-024) mirrors an external threaded conversation into the reviewer inbox. Called by agents at install time (or dynamically â€” e.g. CS agent registers one per ticket started). Returns a mirrorJobId for subsequent management calls.

externalRef.description: The external resource id (ticket id, PR number, channel id, â€¦) used in the fetch capability's arg template

dedupFieldPath.description: JSONPath to the per-message dedup id in the fetch capability's response

fetchCapability.description: Key of a capability tagged mirror_source

webhookUrl.description: Generated webhook URL for this job â€” operator copy-pastes into the external vendor's admin console if webhookEnabled is true

capabilities.display_name: Get sync lag and state for a mirror job
capabilities.description: Query the current state of a sync job. Used by the portal to render "last synced 23s ago" indicators and by agents to decide whether a draft is based on fresh enough state.

lagMs.description: Milliseconds since last successful sync; the inbox UI surfaces this as a last-synced badge

capabilities.display_name: Cancel a thread mirror sync job
capabilities.description: Stop syncing a registered thread mirror job. Idempotent â€” unregistering an unknown job returns ok=true. Pre-existing messages in the thread are preserved; only the sync loop stops.

capabilities.display_name: Get a ticket including thread history
capabilities.description: Fetch full ticket including the message thread. Each thread entry carries its externalMessageId (dedup key) and isPrivate (internal note flag).

isPrivate.description: True for internal notes; mirrored into messages.is_internal

authorKind.description: Who the ticket system logs as the author

externalMessageId.description: Ticket-system id, used as the dedup key during mirror sync (ADR-022)

threadId.description: Stable id used for workflow dedup â€” same thread always same id

capabilities.display_name: List new tickets since a timestamp
capabilities.description: Poll for tickets received since a given timestamp. Used by scheduled CS agents. Implementers: Zendesk, Freshdesk, inbound-email.

Post a reply on a ticket in-system. visibility=public creates a customer-facing comment; visibility=internal creates a private note mirrored into messages.is_internal. Response includes the externalMessageId for immediate dedup backfill.

linkStyle.description: How links show in the sent email: text = the label (or the host for a bare URL), button = a button, plain = the URL itself.

visibility.description: public = customer-facing reply; internal = private note mirrored into messages.is_internal

buttonColor.description: Button colour when linkStyle is button (#rgb or #rrggbb).

externalMessageId.description: Ticket-system id of the newly-created comment; Konstera backfills this on its own message row immediately so sync-tick doesn't have to

capabilities.description: Write triage fields on a ticket: priority, type and tags only (allowlisted by the connector). Used by the CS agent in triage apply mode (ADR-030). Freshdesk: PUT /api/v2/tickets/{id}; priority low/medium/high/urgent = 1-4; the type must be one of the account's ticket types.

type.description: A ticket type the help desk account defines

capabilities.description: Mark a ticket as resolved/closed/pending after a reply is sent.
